cohorts.title_zh: 固定短 K：3/6/8 个 K128 步
cohorts.focus_zh: 依次处理 K384、K768、K1024；隔离固定步数调度、按需 scale 准备与收尾，保持 192x256、8 waves。
cohorts.hypothesis_zh: 短 K 的固定开销占比可能较高；尚无新测量证明瓶颈或收益。

cohorts.title_zh: 扩展短 K、宽 N：12 步
cohorts.focus_zh: 单独评估 12 步流水和 N 扩大后的复用；不直接推广 3/6/8 步配置。
cohorts.hypothesis_zh: K 步数和 N 同时变化，应独立判断启动成本与数据复用的取舍。

cohorts.focus_zh: 固定 N 后检查稳态流水、等待与寄存器活跃范围；形成独立配置。
cohorts.hypothesis_zh: 24 步的预取与稳态开销可能不同于首批短 K。

cohorts.title_zh: 中长 K、宽 N：56 步
cohorts.focus_zh: 分别核对 N6144 和 N7168 子组，研究加载/计算重叠及 M 尾块；保留 M6144 单独回归项。
cohorts.hypothesis_zh: S64 panel 已覆盖 56 步，不能把减少 scale refill 当作本组收益来源。

cohorts.title_zh: 长 K：128 步、scale panel 边界
cohorts.focus_zh: 隔离比较 S64 refill 与 S128 panel 的主循环和 LDS 成本。
cohorts.hypothesis_zh: 减少一次 refill 可能有益，也可能被 LDS 与准备成本抵消；9033 历史局部结果不是全组验收。

cohorts.focus_zh: 检查 N tile、工作组数量与复用的取舍，保留现有小 tile 候选。
cohorts.hypothesis_zh: 窄 N 的网格组织不同于宽 N；同几何 CKTile 获胜不证明某个 OPUS tile 必然最优。

cohorts.title_zh: 窄 N2048、大 M（含近平局）
cohorts.focus_zh: 单独检查 N2048 工作量与 M 变化；(4096,2048,7168) 保持原目标成员。
cohorts.hypothesis_zh: 当前 0.033% 的领先不代表稳定完成；需与新批次波动共同判断。

acceptance.current_execution: This ledger uses only CPU file reads/writes. First25 implementation, CPU layout validation, and offline gfx950/host compilation passed according to the linked evidence. No GPU execution, benchmark, automatic GPU launcher, or automatic retry occurred; GPU numerical and performance acceptance remain pending.
protection: Do not modify kernel 9000 pipeline, traits, registration behavior, call path, or any shared helper in a way that changes 9000.
Keep every prior legal candidate and frozen selection. Do not promote 9040/9041/9042 or overwrite tuning/default choices before validation.
Use single launch, splitK=0, FP8 A/B with preshuffled B, native E8M0 scales, FP32 accumulation, BF16 output, and the existing tensor-byte bound.
correctness: Validate every exact shape of the active cohort before timing; first stage means all 25 original short-K targets.

Use the unchanged independent FP32 reference and tune.compare_outputs contract: error == 0 for every element; interval 1e-4 + 5e-5 * sum(abs(A_i*B_i)), endpoints rounded to BF16. Do not relax tolerance.
Use native E8M0 input replay, NaN-prefilled output, finite/full-write checks and output guard regions, including M%192 tails. Preserve scale grouping/layout and all 3/6/8 K128 contributions.

Check exact-K dispatch rejection outside each candidate K, M64/N256 legality, tensor-byte limits, and unsupported shapes. A broader advertised legal domain needs its own checks; first 25 results alone do not validate all legal M/N combinations.
performance: After GPU use is permitted, use at least five complete matched rounds per shape on one idle physical GPU per shape with candidate order rotated; retain raw timings, source/binary hashes, GPU identity, correctness results, and exclusions.

Retain every legal OPUS 9000/9010/9011/9012/9020/9030/9031/9032/9033 comparator plus the applicable new fixed-K candidate. Retain CK/CKTile/ASM comparison paths and record unsupported or numerically rejected entries explicitly; frozen absence is not zero time.
Use the existing profiler convention (5 warmups, 51 iterations, rotating inputs): common preshuffle/scale preparation/reference and CPU launch overhead excluded; backend-internal transforms included.
Compare complete same-batch medians. Never mix historical and new timings to select the winner, pick the best isolated round, or treat incomplete 903x history as acceptance.
Record improvement over the same-batch old OPUS best separately from success versus the fastest same-batch valid external backend. Only the latter can close a performance target.

Require a strict median win and consistent round evidence to mark a target accepted; close margins (within the existing +/-3% review band), inconsistent rounds, or a tie remain pending additional evidence. A historical 0.033% lead is not stable completion.
progression: For first cohort, work K384 (12 targets), then K768 (12), then K1024 (1), keeping the geometry fixed while isolating the K-schedule feature.
Later cohorts are a proposed sequence, not measured progress. Do not mark a cohort solved until every member passes correctness and performance acceptance, or invent a pass for an untested shape.
Preserve separate pending/failed/pass records for each shape. Stage-one completion would leave 62 original targets (61 current losses and one near-tie current win).

Before claiming all remaining targets solved, revalidate the original 87 as an unchanged exhaustive set and the full supported 295 selection set, retaining prior wins; the 10 pre-existing address-range exclusions stay outside this ledger.

cpu_evidence.scope: First25 candidates only; CPU coordinate/logical-schedule validation and offline gfx950 ISA/host compilation do not establish GPU numerical correctness or performance.
